claim: Patchline ships a million-run adoption milestone with a measured activation, retention, and expansion funnel. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the million-run adoption claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make million-run-adoption-gate`.
